record_type: source-bounded compressed research-object state transport candidate
provenance_rule: Each source_units entry is an immutable parse-unit handle. The effective parse resolves it to repository, commit, path, blob, section and semantic standing. Grouping does not count repeated source locations as independent warrant.

source_described_scope_or_purpose.content: Information-theoretic framework for modeling computational progress as transitions in search-space accessibility.
Phase Boundary Dataset is intended as empirical foundation for testing whether computational paradigm transitions are preceded by aligned information velocity.

source_described_status.content: Theory and measurement protocol are defined; empirical validation through historical case studies and proxy reconstruction is current work.
Source-described remaining work includes historical datasets, Λ_E trajectories, precursor comparisons, predictive evaluation and operational interface tests.
Autodiff transition remains a candidate χ_g structural transition requiring historical reconstruction.

definitions.content: Computational state Ω_t contains context, accessibility, search geometry, searchable dimensionality and utility structure.
Historical transitions are represented as M_old -> M_new and evaluated for structural change.

formal_structures.content: Proposed stochastic capability-evolution model; explicitly not assumed physical law.
Proposed accessibility/visibility model using representational distance, iteration cost, information, alignment, tooling maturity, economic accessibility and prior attention.
Defines aligned information velocity, information gain and utility alignment.
Defines χ transformations, metric/dimensional transformation classes and description-length-based structural detection criterion.
Models causal cascade, resource-vs-structural distinction and stochastic evolution of computational state.

assertions_or_hypotheses.content: Major computational phase boundaries should be preceded by increased aligned information velocity, then accessibility, then capability within a bounded horizon.
Information gain can be valuable through elimination of possibilities; alignment is intended to exclude benchmark gaming and irrelevant optimization.
A genuine structural breakthrough compresses complexity previously carried by a human operator or external process.
R03 defines empirical measurement, case construction, temporal validation, falsification, synthetic stress tests and external-alignment tests for CPB.

Autodiff is treated as candidate geometry-changing transition that transfers derivative complexity to infrastructure and is interpreted as increasing description-length absorption, information velocity and accessibility.
Assembly -> compilers is treated as strong candidate structural transition with complexity absorption, faster iteration and lower representational distance, while acknowledging hardware confound.
Post-2012 deep-learning scaling is treated as a difficult false-negative/resource-confound probe; source reports weaker structural precursors in mature scaling regimes.

Source proposes basin-opening χ events versus basin-mining/exploitation regimes and historical structural-stack accounting; strongest CPB claim is narrowed toward phase boundaries rather than all capability improvement.
Synthetic stress test is interpreted as strong evidence that resource-dominant mature regimes are a boundary of CPB applicability.
Source interprets historical-classification agreement as a positive convergent-validity signal but explicitly not proof and says genuine external testing remains next.
Minimax -> alpha-beta pruning is treated as strong low-confound structural example where pruning preserves perfect-condition minimax result while changing search efficiency.

Source speculates consciousness may be a self-integrating search-process phase boundary with shared representation, self-modeling, internal coordination and recursive optimization; it explicitly does not claim subjective experience solved.
Source reports a playlist-taxonomy transfer, explicitly denies that this validates CPB, and proposes a broader process-taxonomy principle based on induced trajectories.
Emerging-insights documents synthesize bottleneck relocation, search transformation, navigation-instrument, recursive-interface and trajectory-based interpretations of CPB.

Trajectory-coherence document proposes trajectory/attractor-based system understanding and a speculative authenticity formalization, explicitly distinguishing proposed measurement from established measurement.
Falsification document reiterates that capability explosions are downstream consequences of earlier exploration-efficiency transformations and says contrary evidence should reject the framework.

reported_results.content: 1000-transition adversarial sweep reports 77% break/falsification rate overall and ~89% under high resource dominance.
Historical classification exercise reports 80–85% agreement against common historical interpretations; no actual kappa statistic is reported.

reported_negative_results.content: Deep-learning scaling probe reports partial cases of capability growth without clear prior Λ_E and partial resource-dominant explanations.

limitations_or_open_questions.content: Historical proxy reconstruction is uncertain; accessibility functional form is provisional; direct latent-variable recovery is not claimed.
Convergent-validity exercise used no live external raters and is not a true blinded expert study; selection bias remains.
Beautiful conceptual compression without improved prediction, decisions or search is explicitly insufficient.
Open tests ask whether CPB improves external classification/decisions, becomes an exploration-improving interface, and whether trajectory/authenticity signals predict future behavior.

applications_or_examples.content: Repository uses compilers, autodiff, deep-learning scaling and alpha-beta pruning as case-study surfaces with explicitly source-relative classifications.
Repository explores music taxonomy, consciousness, interactions and trajectory coherence as cross-domain/speculative applications or analogues, not established CPB validation.

explicit_cross_repository_references.relation_assertion: Source describes a conceptual relationship/lineage between IICG and CPB.
Source describes Causal Mass as an earlier conceptual step in self-described development chains.

unresolved_references.reason: Source names framework but does not provide exact repository/artifact identity; existing atlas knowledge is not used to resolve it.
Source names framework/concept but exact program object identity is not source-resolved.
